4490-6824--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-6824--210.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
4490-6824--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink by any method.
Gain life by any method.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
4490-6824--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

1744-4881-6909.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
1744-4881-6909.description:
Cast Rite of Replication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2841-3897-7889.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-7889.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1170-2981-5131-7054--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-5131-7054--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gravebreaker Lamia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

2738-4871-5687-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Skittering Precursor, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

549-1978-7908.notablePrerequisites: You control at least X Halflings.
549-1978-7908.description:
Cause The Notary Hobbits to become an artifact using Biotransference.
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2841-6159-7889.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6159-7889.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

338-2685-3263-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2685-3263-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-2511-4871-7316.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3249-4647-5173-6797.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

2034-4013-5050.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
2034-4013-5050.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Chittering Witch.
When Chittering Witch enters, it triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

3259-4460-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
3259-4460-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5086-5183-5231-6291-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
5086-5183-5231-6291-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

2604-3532-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

880-5478-7705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5478-7705.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3946-5033-7705.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1676-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures you control minus 1 due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2074-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2074-4050-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

67-2034-4053-7410.description:
Cast Rhys by paying {1}{W} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rhys.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, its ability and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rhys from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

240-5223-5231-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2085-7163-7172.description:
Activate Sunken Palace's second ability by paying {1}{U}, tapping it and exiling seven cards from your graveyard, adding {U}.
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, ensuring to use the mana from Sunken Palace, targeting a triggered ability.
Sunken Palace triggers. Holding priority, activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {1}{R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Resolve the first Sunken Palace trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting a Sunken Palace trigger.
Resolve the Mister Fantastic ability, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6.

232-1235-3277-4285.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Izzet Chronarch.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Izzet Chronarch with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Izzet Chronarch tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1887-3557-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1887-3557-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage using Brago. Brago triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

549-856-5226-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3234-3293-3967-5413.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-3967-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-3967-5413.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2730-5147-6553.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2730-5147-6553.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

997-2533-3388-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
Repeat.

2713-3719-4264-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Altered Ego and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Altered Ego from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Altered Ego to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Altered Ego enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Altered Ego by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-3363-5078-5645.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

678-2445-5296.description:
Cast Workhorse by paying {6}, causing it to enter the battlefield with eight +1/+1 counters on it due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until Workhorse has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Workhorse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

152-1283-1308-2719.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Chromatic Orrery.
Activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding {10}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead tap the Chromatic Orrery tokens to draw infinite cards, or target any artifact(s) using Cogwork Assembler's ability.

662-905-3263-4853.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Liquimetal Coating.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1651-1961-4680-4871.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature.
The creature dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Throne of Geth trigger, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasure and The Hollow Sentinel, untapping Throne of Geth.
Repeat.
